story.titleZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿获得法拉利车队生涯首个杆位
story.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿表示获得法拉利车队生涯首个杆位非常特别，为此他努力了很长时间。
story.originalTitle: Lewis 🗣️ "It’s an incredibly special feeling to take my first pole position for Ferrari. I’ve been working towards a moment like this for a long...
story.summaryEn:
Lewis 🗣️ "It’s an incredibly special feeling to take my first pole position for Ferrari. I’ve been working towards a moment like this for a long time, so to finally achieve it means a lot."
A positive Saturday for the team 🇲🇽
detailZh:
刘易斯·汉密尔顿（汉密尔顿）表示：“获得法拉利车队生涯首个杆位是一种非常特别的感觉。我为此努力了很长时间，所以最终实现这个目标意义重大。”
“对于车队来说，这是一个积极的周六。”
detailEn:
Lewis 🗣️ "It’s an incredibly special feeling to take my first pole position for Ferrari. I’ve been working towards a moment like this for a long time, so to finally achieve it means a lot."
A positive Saturday for the team 🇲🇽
